description: List maintenance tickets for a building, optionally filtered by status (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, CANCELLED)

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.

status.description: Only tickets with this status. Defaults to all statuses.

name: list_maintenance_tickets
title: Maintenance tickets
